messages:
Anika: Quick notes from the all-hands Q&A on GTM/partners. Dropping questions here so we can track responses and follow-ups.

Rafael: Thanks! First ask 1: can we get a short rubric that says when Partnerships leads the motion vs when Sales retains ownership? Too many handoffs right now.

Mina: TL;DR: Partnerships leads for strategically embedded integrations or deals > $500k ARR; Sales handles transactional resells/referrals. I'll draft a 1-page rubric and link it here by Wednesday.

TJ: Attribution question: how will we tag and report partner-influenced opportunities in SFDC? Ops needs something measurable for the next exec review.

Kelsey: We're adding an introduced_by field + partner_utm to capture origin. Ops ran a pilot and partner-sourced leads had a ~20% higher conversion to SQL in the pilot cohort. Will publish the dashboard next Monday.

Rafael: Can Partnerships post an interim roster of active co-sell partners and what stage each opportunity is in? That helps reps decide who to engage.

Mina: Yep 1 I'll upload a CSV with partner names, stage buckets (MQL, SQL, PO, Contract), and rep owners. Expect it by EOD Tue.

Nora: Product ask: partners want estimated ship dates for VPC GA and the new Optimize batching APIs so they can plan integration work. Any timeline?

Anika: VPC private deployment GA target still late Q2; Optimize batching features slated for early Q3. We'll produce a partner-facing roadmap snapshot after the rubric and CSV are live.

TJ: SLA/PoC process: can we spin up Dedicated trials for partner joint PoCs? Need guardrails (duration, quotas).

Mina: Yes 1 Partners with an executed NDA + partner agreement can request a 30-day Dedicated trial, capped at 2TB tokens/day. Send requests to partners@redwood.ai and include Deal Desk sign-off.

Kelsey: Sales enablement action: I'll draft a one-pager for reps summarizing co-sell criteria, trial process, and required SFDC fields. Requesting review from @Rafael and @Mina by Friday.

Rafael: Will review. Also need a one-slide ROI template to use in weekly deal reviews for partner-influenced opportunities.

Mina: I'll prepare a joint-case-study template and a tech/legal handoff checklist to accompany the ROI slide.

allhands-bot: Recording + transcript are available: https://meetings.redwood.ai/rec/1936009876 (internal)

Anika: Final consolidation plan: I'll package the rubric, partner roster CSV, one-pager, and roadmap snapshot and share a single link by Thursday COB. If you need exec escalation for any partner ask, reply here with 1-2 line context and desired outcome.

TJ: Escalation: Partner Z requested priority GPU capacity for an enterprise PoC next week. Requesting leadership sign-off to increase throttle quota temporarily.

Anika: @TJ noted. Please DM me the account, PoC scope, and expected ARR. We'll triage in today's GTM sync.

Rafael: Thanks all 1 will add the ROI slide to next week's deal review pack.
